title: Hollow Knight Macebug Mace
description: Adds the ability to change the mace texture to use Macebug from Hollow Knight when renaming the mace to "Macebug"
body:
A resource pack that allows you to change the mace to have it's heavy core part replaced with Macebug.
To see this effect, rename the mace to "Macebug".

My other Hollow Knight related packs:
- [Hollow Knight Nail Swords](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/hollow-knight-nail-swords)
- [Silksong Needle Spears](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/silksong-needle-spears)
